svg.aria-label: The robustness frontier on CIFAR-10 (L∞, ε = 8/255, AutoAttack)
svg.text: The robustness frontier on CIFAR-10 (L∞, ε = 8/255, AutoAttack)
Each point is a published model: clean test accuracy against accuracy under attack. Six years moved the frontier up ~30 points.
